    m=(t>=lo)&(t<lo+0.5)
    if m.sum()<8: continue
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),np.log(e[m])])
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,np.log(-s[m]),rcond=None)
    A2=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),e[m],e[m]**2,e[m]**3])

    r=s[m]-A2@c2
